lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 primary high-contrast vertical lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is approximately regular with minor narrowing towards the cranial direction.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Visible bifurcation at the ventral terminus of the 8th vertical line (counting from cranial to caudal).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 11th vertical line and several posterior segments are abbreviated; numerous isolated white spots exist between and behind the main line array.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-density cluster of approximately 9 distinct white spots located on the posterior lateral haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A sequence of three spots aligns horizontally across the mid-thigh region of the hind limb.

other_distinctive_markers: Characteristic white chevron between the eyes, white spot on the cheek, and a large white patch on the lower throat area.
